method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Umbrella Sword (伞剑/傘剣)
skills.line: The umbrella is mightier than the sword!
skills.description: Faster than the eye can see, Ubume pulls out her umbrella and strikes a single target, dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK and ignores 20% of the their DEF.

skills.name: Co-op (协战/協戦)
skills.line: It feels like rain! Let me lend you my umbrella...
skills.description:
Ubume has a 30% chance to Assist.
If her total ATK is the highest among non-summoned allies, she also gains First Feathers.
 When Ubume is deployed and wins a battle, EXP awarded increases by 9%.
;First Feathers (羽初)
:
:'''General, Mark''': Increases her damage dealt by 100% and her chance to Assist by 60%.
;Assist
: When an ally uses a normal attack to attack an enemy, will also use normal attack to attack the same target.

skills.name: Hack and Slash (天翔鹤斩/天翔鶴切)
skills.line: It's raining, it's pouring... My umbrella is goring!
skills.description: Using her umbrella as a sword, Ubume inflicts a barrage of 3 attacks on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 33% of her ATK with each ATK. Also the finishing slash on the targeted enemy deals damage equal to 88% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 35% and finishing slash damage increases to 93%.
Damage increases to 37% and finishing slash damage increases to 98%.
Damage increases to 39% and finishing slash damage increases to 103%.
Damage increases to 41% and finishing slash damage increases to 108%. If the HP of the enemy is less than 60% or if they're the last enemy standing, damage for the finishing slash increases to 200%.

bio.condition: With Ubume clear stage 5 of the Orochi soul zone (solo).
